//: SwayNotificationCenter: the notification daemon plus a control center.
This file is plain JSON and accepts no comments, so the documentation lives
in these '//' keys, which swaync ignores.
The center opens from the bell icon in Waybar, or with: swaync-client -t -sw
//position: Corner where the notifications and the center appear. The bar sits at the
top with the bell on the right, so the center opens just below it.
The margin-top of 44 is the bar height (38) plus its margin (6).
//layers: 'overlay' puts notifications above even fullscreen windows, so a warning
is not missed while gaming or watching something.
//sizes: Width of the center and of individual notifications, in pixels.
//timeouts: Seconds until a notification disappears on its own.
'critical' uses timeout 0, meaning it stays until you interact. That is
right: a dying battery or a disk failure must not vanish by itself.
//widgets: Order of the blocks inside the control center, top to bottom.
Remove what you don't use; the order here is the order on screen.
title         header with the clear-all button
mpris         media controls with album art
volume        volume slider, with a per-output list when expanded

//device: The same device Waybar uses: a laptop with an NVIDIA GPU.
